+ Adds automatic m3u4u playlist/EPG refresh on the first Adult TV Test open per Kodi session when a saved Adult IPTV configuration exists. If a Site update is installed first, the m3u4u refresh is deferred until the newly installed version is loaded.

+ Expands saved channel resolution labels to 360p, 480p, 540p, 576p, 720p and 1080p across supported Site checks.
